title: Region part FeatureCollection
description: data/regions/parts/<region_id>/<part_id>.geojson — one generation unit (typically one borough) of a region assembled from parts. Carries facilities only; the region's metadata lives once, in the manifest.

region_id.description: The region this part belongs to — the merged file's region_id, not a slug of its own.

part_id.description: Must match the manifest entry and the filename.

subregions.description: Divisions *inside* this part (neighborhoods or precincts within the borough). Each must nest under a sub-region via `parent` — a part never declares a top-level division, so two parts generated in parallel can't collide.
